question: Compare the Atlas and Boreal standard return windows and refund remedies.
reference_answer: Atlas: 21 days and original-payment refund; Boreal: 14 days and store credit.
answer:
- Atlas accepts unused standard goods within 21 calendar days of delivery while Boreal has a different policy. [meridian.pdf, p. 1]

- Approved refunds for Atlas returns are issued to the original payment method within five business days after warehouse inspection. [meridian.pdf, p. 1]

- The Boreal desk has a different policy even when the item has the same catalogue description. [meridian.pdf, p. 1]

- Warranty repair is a separate process for Atlas that does not extend the 21-day standard return window. [meridian.pdf, p. 1]
